details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_labels.py:491-496 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_prefetch_repo_labels` does not catch `http.client.HTTPException` (including `IncompleteRead`), so a truncated response escapes the prefetch and aborts the sync.
  WHY: The sync fails with a traceback instead of logging one line and falling back to per-label GETs. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 and luna rated it NIT, glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR (highest used, mapped to high). The old per-label path has the same gap, so this is not a regression.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2072 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The CI step runs under set -euo pipefail, so when `cmd_sync_labels` returns 1 the whole step exits immediately.
  WHY: `cmd_sync_labels` returns 1 when all label API calls fail, which contradicts the requirement that transport and HTTP errors stay non-fatal. Severity was given as BLOCKER (mapped to critical). The same issue is reported as a task gap in the consensus task gaps.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:528-567 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The label prefetch read runs before the per-label description validation in the sync loop.
  WHY: Validation does not come before every GitHub read, so a listing call can happen for contracts that fail validation. Severity given as NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Transport or HTTP errors stay non-fatal so CI does not flake on token or rate-limit issues."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, "AI label sync dry-run smoke" step
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The step runs `sync-labels` under `set -euo pipefail` (lines 2070-2075). `cmd_sync_labels` returns 1 when every label errors (scripts/ai_labels.py:783), so the step exits before the inline Python assertion (lines 2076-2102) runs. Severity: MAJOR from minimax, luna and glm; NIT from sonnet-5_5, which notes the behavior predates the PR.
- requirement: "Run `_label_sync_validation_error(expected_metadata)` right after the name-validation check and before any GitHub read."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_labels.py, `cmd_sync_labels`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: `_prefetch_repo_labels(repo)` is called at lines 528-538 before the label loop, and description validation sits at lines 558-568, after that read. The over-limit test does not track the prefetch request. Severity: NIT. sonnet-5_5 judged this not a defect and rated it confidence 2.
- requirement: "If the prefetch fails or returns malformed data, log one line to stderr and fall back to the current per-label GET path for every label."
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_labels.py, `_prefetch_repo_labels`
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Lines 499-512 validate only that the label is a dict with a non-empty `name`. They do not check `color` or `description`, so a malformed entry is stored instead of triggering the fallback. Severity: MAJOR from gemini, NIT from minimax, luna and glm (glm confidence 3).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/ai_labels.py:490-495 (`_prefetch_repo_labels` except clause; `response.read()` at line 245) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `http.client.IncompleteRead` and other `HTTPException` errors are not `OSError` subclasses, so a truncated response body escapes the prefetch.
  WHY: `cmd_sync_labels` aborts with a traceback instead of falling back to per-label GETs. The old per-label path has the same gap and the trigger is rare. The fix is to add `http.client.HTTPException` to the tuple.
- TASK_GAP: requirement "Transport or HTTP errors stay non-fatal so CI does not flake on token or rate-limit issues." | site: "AI label sync dry-run smoke" step in .github/workflows/ci.yml | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Evidence of absence: Under `set -euo pipefail`, `cmd_sync_labels` returns 1 when every label errors (scripts/ai_labels.py line 783), so the step exits non-zero before the assertion runs. This existed before the PR. The ci.yml comment overstates non-fatal handling.
- TASK_GAP: requirement "Run `_label_sync_validation_error(expected_metadata)` right after the name-validation check and before any GitHub read." | site: scripts/ai_labels.py, `cmd_sync_labels` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  Evidence of absence: The per-label check is correctly placed. The single list prefetch at lines 531-534 still runs before the loop, but the issue says to prefetch "before the loop", so it was not raised as a gap.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/ai_labels.py, `_prefetch_repo_labels` except clause; add `import http.client` and `http.client.HTTPException` to the tuple (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:2072 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The CI step runs under set -euo pipefail. If cmd_sync_labels returns 1, the entire step exits immediately.
  WHY: cmd_sync_labels returns 1 when all label API calls fail (e.g., total network outage or token expiration). That makes the entire CI step exit fatally, violating the requirement that transport and HTTP errors stay non-fatal.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:528-567 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The label prefetch read is performed before the label description validation inside the sync loop.
  WHY: The requirement to validate before any GitHub read is violated, causing potentially unnecessary API listing calls for contracts that fail validation.
- TASK_GAP: requirement "Run _label_sync_validation_error(expected_metadata) right after the name-validation check and before any GitHub read." | site: scripts/ai_labels.py, cmd_sync_labels | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Evidence of absence: _prefetch_repo_labels (a GitHub listing read) is called at lines 528-531, before the loop and before the description validation at line 558.
- TASK_GAP: requirement "If the prefetch fails or returns malformed data, log one line to stderr and fall back to the current per-label GET path for every label." | site: scripts/ai_labels.py, _prefetch_repo_labels | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Evidence of absence: Lines 499-512 validate only the label name, not `description` or `color`. Malformed labels are treated as valid prefetch results.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP_1: requirement "Transport or HTTP errors stay non-fatal so CI does not flake on token or rate-limit issues" and "fail the step when any entry in payload["errors"] has action == "validate", or a message containing 100-character limit" | site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, "AI label sync dry-run smoke" step | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Evidence of absence: Under `set -euo pipefail` (line 2072 in the diff hunk), a non-zero exit from `cmd_sync_labels` ends the step before the inline Python assertion (lines 2081-2102) runs. The assertion cannot observe validate errors in that case.
- TASK_GAP_2: requirement "Validate locally before reads. In cmd_sync_labels, run _label_sync_validation_error(expected_metadata) right after the name-validation check and before any GitHub read." | site: scripts/ai_labels.py, cmd_sync_labels | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Evidence of absence: `_prefetch_repo_labels(repo)` is called at lines 531-538 before the label loop, and validation sits at lines 558-567. The test `test_sync_labels_rejects_overlong_description_before_get` does not exclude the prefetch URL. The CHANGELOG line makes the same claim that the code does not deliver.
- TASK_GAP_3: requirement "If the prefetch fails or returns malformed data, log one line to stderr and fall back to the current per-label GET path for every label." | site: scripts/ai_labels.py, _prefetch_repo_labels | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Evidence of absence: Lines 499-512 accept any dict with a non-empty `name`, and never check `color` or `description`. A malformed entry is stored and treated as an update candidate instead of triggering the fallback.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS 1: scripts/ai_labels.py, `_prefetch_repo_labels` except clause (around line 487 of the diff hunk); add `http.client.HTTPException` to the third except tuple (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS 2: tests/test_ai_labels.py, `_run_sync_labels` `_fake_urlopen` (around lines 178-190 of the diff hunk); raise a labelled sentinel for the `prefetch_pages is None` branch (about 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

  PROBLEM: The prefetch does not catch http.client.HTTPException, including http.client.IncompleteRead, raised when reading a truncated response.
  WHY: The exception escapes the prefetch and sync command instead of logging the prefetch failure and falling back to per-label GETs.
- TASK_GAP: requirement "Run _label_sync_validation_error(expected_metadata) right after the name-validation check and before any GitHub read." | site: scripts/ai_labels.py, cmd_sync_labels | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Evidence of absence: `_prefetch_repo_labels(repo)` is called at lines 531-533 before the label loop, so the description validation at lines 558-568 runs after a GitHub read. The overlong-description test tracks per-label requests separately and does not detect the prefetch.
- TASK_GAP: requirement "If the prefetch 'returns malformed data,' log one line and fall back to per-label GETs." | site: scripts/ai_labels.py, _prefetch_repo_labels | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Evidence of absence: Lines 499-512 accept a dict with a non-empty name without validating `color` and `description`. `_label_sync_matches` then treats missing fields as mismatches instead of triggering the fallback.
- TASK_GAP: requirement "Transport or HTTP errors stay non-fatal so CI does not flake on token or rate-limit issues." | site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, "AI label sync dry-run smoke" | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Evidence of absence: The command runs at lines 2072-2075 under set -e. `cmd_sync_labels` returns 1 when all labels have errors (scripts/ai_labels.py:772-783), so the step exits before the new assertion.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/ai_labels.py:491-496 (`_prefetch_repo_labels` except clauses; root cause at lines 244-245 and 251 in `_github_api_request`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The prefetch except tuple catches only `urllib.error.HTTPError`, `LabelContractError`, and `(urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError)`. A truncated chunked response makes `response.read()` at line 245 raise `http.client.IncompleteRead`, which is not an `OSError`.
  WHY: `IncompleteRead` escapes `_prefetch_repo_labels` and `cmd_sync_labels`, so one truncated listing aborts the sync with a traceback instead of falling back. It is not a regression, because the old per-label path has the same gap.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:499-512 and 280-283 (`_prefetch_repo_labels` page-item loop; `_label_sync_matches`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The prefetch accepts any dict whose `name` is a non-empty string, even with `color` or `description` missing, instead of treating it as malformed data.
